name: VIP Black & Gold — All-Purpose Signature
description: VIP Black & Gold is Nexora’s all-purpose premium website design. Its onyx-and-champagne-gold visual system adapts to your own services, team, photos, offers and booking settings—whether you run a salon, barber shop, spa, skin clinic, nail studio, tattoo studio or wellness business.
tagline: An all-purpose premium experience for beauty, grooming, wellness and signature services

name: Hair & Styling Studio
description: Welcome to our studio. We bring together master precision haircuts, bespoke balayage, sculpted gel nail art, and restorative hair spa therapies in a modern luxury sanctuary.
tagline: Precision Cuts, Creative Hair Artistry & Luxury Salon Lounge

name: The Royal Blade Barber & Men's Club
description: Situated on Bandra’s iconic 33rd Road, The Royal Blade revives the timeless charm of Victorian barbershops infused with vintage mahogany, genuine brass fittings, and old-school hot towel straight razor mastery.
tagline: Vintage Heritage Shaves, Bespoke Fades & Handcrafted Beard Sculpting

name: Aura Unisex Salon & Wellness Lounge
description: Aura Unisex Salon offers a balanced, contemporary space in Koramangala. Designed for modern professionals and families seeking premium hair services, de-tan treatments, and express grooming under one roof.
tagline: Harmonious Beauty, Contemporary Hair & Inclusive Self-Care

name: Roop Mahal Beauty Parlour & Makeover Space
description: Serving patrons for over 18 years in Connaught Place, Roop Mahal blends classic Indian herbal beauty secrets like turmeric, saffron, and sandalwood with modern waxing and gold facials.
tagline: Timeless Indian Beauty, Herbal Facials, Threading & Radiance Care

name: Pinky Nails Studio
description: Located in posh Jubilee Hills, Pinky Nails Studio is a boutique sanctuary for high-definition nail art, lash extensions, and brow lamination. We combine sterilized medical-grade tools, 9-free toxin-safe gel polishes, and custom aesthetic designs in a serene luxury studio.
tagline: Glossy Chrome Gel Nails, Sculpted Extensions, Lash Lifts & Laminated Brows

name: Kesh Prakriti Hair Spa & Scalp Sanctuary
description: Nestled in quiet Alwarpet, Chennai, Kesh Prakriti specializes in trichology-backed scalp rejuvenation. Using Japanese ultrasonic mist and traditional Indian medicinal herbs, we reverse scalp stress, hair thinning, and urban pollution.
tagline: Deep Zen Head Spa, Micro-Mist Scalp Detox & Botanical Revitalization

name: Dermacure Aesthetic Dermatology & Laser Clinic
description: Dermacure in Gurugram brings US-FDA approved technologies, medical-grade HydraFacials, and customized peeling regimens under the direct guidance of certified dermatologists for radiant, healthy Indian skin.
tagline: Evidence-Based Medi-Facials, Chemical Peels & Certified Dermatological Care

name: Vogue Noir Makeup Studio & Academy
description: Situated in the chic lanes of Koregaon Park, Pune, Vogue Noir is an elite editorial makeup studio. We craft camera-ready looks for red carpets, commercial shoots, and luxury receptions with luminous liquid gold highlights.
tagline: Glamorous Runway Looks, High-Definition Airbrush & Editorial Portfolios

name: Bodhi Tree Massage & Wellness Sanctuary
description: Set amidst peaceful surroundings in Candolim, Goa, Bodhi Tree integrates warm Himalayan salt stones, bamboo wood rolls, and therapeutic essential oils to relieve chronic muscle knots and urban fatigue.
tagline: Peaceful Sanctuary, Himalayan Hot Stone Therapy & Deep Stress Dissolution

name: Prism & Chroma Hair Color Atelier
description: Located on Wood Street in Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Prism & Chroma is an avant-garde hair coloring studio. From honey caramel dimensional balayage to bold fantasy pastels, our certified color masters formulate custom shades tailored to Indian skin tones.
tagline: Hand-Painted Balayage, Luminous Metallics & Custom Fantasy Swatches

name: Shringaar Royal Indian Bridal Lounge
description: Perched on MI Road in Jaipur, Shringaar is Rajasthan’s most celebrated bridal makeover sanctuary. We specialize in grand wedding day makeup, royal zardozi dupatta settings, airbrush longevity, and customized 7-day pre-bridal ubtan rituals.
tagline: Royal Rajputana Trousseaus, Sabyasachi Aesthetic & Heirloom Makeover Packages

name: Iron & Ink Urban Tattoo & Body Art Studio
description: Located in bohemian Hauz Khas Village, New Delhi, Iron & Ink is a studio dedicated to custom blackwork, fine-line realism, and sterile body piercings using 100% single-use disposable needles.
tagline: High-Contrast Monochrome, Custom Dark Realism & Surgical Piercings

name: Arch & Flutter Lash & Brow Bar
description: A chic, intimate micro-studio on Santa Cruz’s Linking Road in Mumbai. Arch & Flutter is devoted purely to eye aesthetics: ultra-light Russian volume lash extensions, semi-permanent feather microblading, and keratin lifts.
tagline: Feather Microblading, Russian Fluffy Volume & Brow Lamination

name: Veda Sanjeevani Ayurvedic Wellness & Spa
description: Housed in an authentic heritage courtyard in Fort Kochi, Kerala, Veda Sanjeevani practices pure Ashtanga Ayurveda under the stewardship of traditional Vaidyas. Experience centuries-old Abhyanga, warm oil Shirodhara, Vedic herbal lepams, and authentic panchakarma rituals.
tagline: Authentic Kerala Panchakarma, Medicated Shirodhara & Vedic Herbal Lepams

name: Sattva Ayurvedic & Wellness Spa
description: Set beside the Ganges in Rishikesh, Sattva Ayurvedic & Wellness Spa unites classical Ashtanga Ayurveda with modern wellness care. Every journey begins with a Nadi Pariksha pulse diagnosis, followed by bespoke therapies in authentic Dhanwantharam and Bringamadi herbs that restore Vata, Pitta, and Kapha balance.
tagline: Dosha-Balancing Herbal Therapies, Nadi Pariksha Consultations & Deep Restorative Wellness

name: Maison Éclat Luxury Hair Atelier
description: Housed in a private atelier on Lavelle Road, New Delhi, Maison Éclat is a luxury hair house where every appointment opens with a bespoke hair-mapping consultation. Our Kérastase-certified master artists craft precision dry sculpting, hand-painted balayage, Olaplex molecular repair, and mirror-gloss keratin rituals with couture precision.
tagline: Haute Hair Couture, Kérastase Rituals & Red-Carpet Precision Gloss

name: Rose & Ivory Bridal Atelier
description: Tucked into a sunlit studio off Linking Road, Bandra, Rose & Ivory is a high-end bridal and makeover house where every bridal story begins with a personalized moodboard. From sweatproof HD airbrush glam to deep skin prep hydration rituals and sculptural saree draping, our artists craft camera-ready looks that hold their glow through the longest celebrations.
tagline: HD Airbrush Bridal Glam, Moodboard-Driven Styling & Flawless Camera-Ready Portraits

name: Cedar & Bloom Family Salon
description: Tucked into a bright corner of Viman Nagar, Cedar & Bloom is a modern unisex family salon built for busy households. From signature wash and style cuts to express glow facials and hydra-infusion hair spas, our quick, nourishing services suit all age groups—because healthy hair and skin should never require a whole day.
tagline: Quick Family Cuts, Express Glow & Everyday Hair Health for Every Generation

name: The Iron Standard Barber & Grooming Club
description: A members-grade gentlemen’s club in Cyber City, Gurugram, where The Iron Standard treats grooming as a daily ritual. Royal straight-razor beard sculpts, executive cuts with scalp rubs, and charcoal detox facials—every visit closes with hot towel therapy and a clean, sharp look.
tagline: Straight-Razor Precision, Hot Towel Rituals & Members-Grade Grooming

name: Peony & Lacquer Lash, Brow & Nail Bar
description: A three-in-one micro-bar in Frazer Town, Bengaluru, where Peony & Lacquer unites nail couture, Russian volume lashes, and brow lamination under one roof. Every service runs on non-damaging organic formulas, precise detailing, and long-lasting retention—so your trendy aesthetic holds from day one to day twenty.
tagline: Lacquer Couture, Feather Lashes & Laminated Brows—All in One Bar

name: Porcelain Skin Lab Medi-Spa & Aesthetics Clinic
description: A calm, porcelain-white clinic in Alipore, Kolkata, where Porcelain Skin Lab pairs dermatologist-tested protocols with the comfort of a spa. From Advanced HydraFacial MD to LED anti-aging and micro-needling collagen boosters, every treatment targets deep cellular renewal and skin texture smoothing—with zero downtime.
tagline: Dermatologist-Led Skin Science, Spa-Grade Comfort & Zero-Downtime Glow

name: Terra Botanica Organic & Bio-Salon
description: A zero-waste bio-salon in Gandhipuram, Coimbatore, where Terra Botanica cares for hair and skin with 100% vegan, chemical-free formulations. From botanical herbal color to cold-pressed eco-gloss spas, every ingredient is ethically sourced to nurture—so the radiance you see is gentle, natural, and unmistakably you.
tagline: 100% Vegan Color, Plant-Based Facials & Zero-Waste Hair Rituals

name: Blink Express Beauty Bar
description: A zero-wait express beauty bar in Jayanagar, Bengaluru, where Blink turns your busiest routine into a perfect 15-minute refresh. From 15-Min Express Blowdries to Instant Flash Glow Cleanups, every service delivers fast application, instant visible freshness, and perfect results for busy routines.
tagline: Walk-In Express Beauty—Perfect Freshness in 15 Minutes, Zero Wait

name: Baan Sen Thai & Oriental Massage Center
description: A candle-lit oriental sanctuary in Kovalam, Kerala, where Baan Sen practices traditional Thai and oriental massage exactly as generations of healers taught it. From dry Thai stretches to aroma herbal oils and reflexology foot pressure, every session unblocks the body’s Sen energy lines—delivering full muscle tension relief and deep mental rejuvenation.
tagline: Ancient Thai Stretch, Sen Line Therapy & Oriental Calm

name: Scissors & Sprinkles Kids & Teens Fun Hair Studio
description: A candy-coloured playroom salon in Adyar, Chennai, where Scissors & Sprinkles turns haircuts into celebrations. Every service runs on tear-free gentle products inside an interactive fun environment, so kids walk out grinning with trendy safe styling—and parents walk out relaxed.
tagline: First Haircuts, Cool Cuts & Tween Fresh—Fun, Fear-Free & Trendy

name: Azure Palms Luxury Hotel & Resort Spa
description: Perched on the shores of Lake Pichola, Udaipur, Azure Palms is a 5-star resort spa where every ritual is an occasion. From Destination Sunset Body Polishes to Rose & Wine Couple Journeys, essential oil scents, deep stress relief, and pampering sensory experiences define every corner of the estate.
tagline: Lake-View Suites, Sunset Rituals & 5-Star Sensory Pampering

name: Vedvriksha Vedic Ayurveda Wellness Studio
description: A warm, marigold-scented wellness studio in Gopalpura, Jaipur, where Vedvriksha practices time-honoured Ayurvedic therapy with modern care. From Abhyanga body massage and Shirodhara to Kashaya Sekam detox and Kadi/Janu Vashti pain relief, every treatment is designed to restore your body’s natural balance.
tagline: Time-Honoured Ayurvedic Therapies—Abhyanga, Shirodhara & Vedic Herbal Care
